validated_properties: Nov-Dec observations map to the calendar-year breeding-season start; January maps to the previous year; off-window dates fail closed.
Banding seasons map to cohort start years and overlapping band intervals fail closed.
Pre-breeder, first breeder, and later non-breeder states are reconstructed from canonical documented Eggs/Chicks codes.
Ross prospecting visits remain available as a multi-colony candidate set within PB seasons.
A prior Beaufort breeding event prevents a later Ross breeding observation from being treated as first reproduction.
Breeding evidence at multiple colonies in one season is flagged ambiguous and excluded from first-breeding choice construction.
Chicks=9-only breeder seasons remain unknown rather than being coded as reproductive failure.
The banded-breeder performance index gives one binary contribution per breeder-season and standardizes only complete three-colony years.
Choice rows attach prior-year performance, natal-colony indicator, and prior-year colony size and exclude entire events when a candidate control is missing.
